summary: feat(dndbeyond): add local read-only character snapshot and PDF inspection
reason: The printed rules-only surface could not share user-authorized character-sheet information without implying an unsupported private API. This narrow local command accepts a user-supplied Beyond20/D&D Beyond JSON snapshot or exported PDF, including D&D Beyond page-level widget exports without an AcroForm field tree, omits identity/narrative/secrets, and never makes remote requests.
validated_outcome: focused normalizer tests pass; synthetic AcroForm and user-provided D&D Beyond widget PDF extraction pass; CLI and MCP binaries build; live D&D Beyond requests are unchanged

deferred_to_upstream.reason: Beyond20 reads the live browser sheet and forwards messages; D&D Beyond does not publish a supported character-data API. Any future browser discovery must be separately user-consented and must pass replayability and terms review.
